title: BMP4-induced symmetry breaking in a 3D model of the human epiblast
protocol: Place aliquots of Matrigel, hydrogel, and an empty 2 mL tube on ice.
Dissociate hESCs with Accutase as single cells and spin cells at 300 g for 3 min.
Resuspend the cells in hESC media to a concentration of 1–2x10^6 cells/mL.
Add ~30 µL of cell suspension to an empty tube on ice.
Mix in 30 µL Matrigel followed by 150 µL hydrogel and aspirate-release several times with the P1000 pipette tip to disperse the cells throughout the gel until the mixture appears homogenous.
Transfer the cell-gel mix to the bottom of a 35-mm dish in a snake-like pattern, covering most or the entire surface.
Transfer the dish to the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for ~5 minutes to solidify the gel.
Supplement hESC media with 10 μM ROCK inhibitor Y27632 and optionally pen/strep or equivalent antibiotic.
Seed cells in gel and incubate for ~24 hours.
Replace medium with hESC medium (MEF-CM + 20 ng/mL bFGF) optionally supplemented with pen/strep after 24 hours of seeding.
Refresh media and add morphogen, such as 1 ng/mL BMP4, for 24–48 hours.
Perform immunofluorescence staining at the bench or live-cell imaging in an environmental chamber atop a microscope.
Wash dish once with DPBS +/+.
Add 4% PFA.
Spin down at 100 g for 90 s if gel is loose or broken off.
Resuspend in DPBS+/+ after spinning down.
Repeat spin down cycle if necessary.
Keep in PFA for 30–60 min.
Remove PFA and wash once in DPBS+/+.
Block with 2% BSA in PBST.
Keep in block solution for at least 1 hour in the fridge.
Perform spin down cycle between each wash step from this point onward if gel loosens.
Do not aspirate supernatant between spin downs; gently remove it with a P1000 pipette instead.
Replace media with primary antibodies dissolved in block solution and keep overnight in the fridge.
Wash twice in PBST after staining with primary antibodies.
Resuspend in secondary antibody and DAPI dissolved in block solution for 30 min at room temperature in a dark chamber.
Wash secondary antibody twice in PBST.
Move sample to an imaging dish and keep in PBST.
